1935, May
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. S.
Page 353 Cont.
May 28 Mrs. Martha Miller - in Mayo Brs. - blood poison ask prayers.
John Sau - 34 - Partially cured rhumatism - in Florida - now home and able to walk - on back for 4 mo's.
Pages 354, 366 through 373, and 375 are just names and addresses for help wanted, etc.
Pages 355 through 365 and 374 are blank pages.
END OF FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
